links.targetTitle: LI.FI: The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive

title: The agentic economy is a financial system where AI agents autonomously hold balances, transact, and authorize payments
content:
The **agentic economy** describes a financial system where AI agents autonomously hold balances, sign transactions, negotiate terms, and authorize payments with minimal human intervention. Microsoft researchers (Rothschild, Mobius, Hofman) formalized the concept in May 2025.

**Key reframing:** when billions of agents represent consumers to businesses, *"trust, and not attention, is now the scarce resource"* — the attention economy's advertising logic doesn't work on software that can't be persuaded, only verified.

**Why it matters:** it defines a new market structure where the customers, workers, and merchants can all be software.

Source: LI.FI, "The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive" (https://li.fi/knowledge-hub/the-agentic-economy-%E2%80%94-a-deep-dive).
